title: Rotate homepage featured originals on each visit
user_quote: The poem in the home page should not be fixed

implementation.selection: Random starting original per language, then advance on each fresh document load using only edition/poem IDs in session storage. Keep the selected cards still while reading and switching language.
implementation.pool: Keep all eligible current-edition originals; fill languages with fewer than three candidates from older editions, newest first and in publication order. The current pool contains three Odia, three Hindi and seven English originals.
implementation.preserved: All 11 existing current-edition card bodies unchanged; original poetry, approved excerpt formatting, display-title overrides, bylines, portraits, poem/profile links, language choices, quiet reader, header, edition cover navigation, consent and service settings preserved.
implementation.ancillary_check_fix: Replace the article-coverage test’s stale fixed cache-version expectation with a valid versioned module assertion; no engagement runtime behavior changed.

checklist.route: index.html; existing homepage featured poem component
checklist.purpose: Offer a different source-backed original when returning or refreshing; read the poem or visit its poet.
checklist.source_relationships: Eleven current Issue 48 originals plus two Hindi originals from Issue 47; no generated translations added.
checklist.layout_art_and_sharing: Existing card markup, portraits, styles, sharing metadata and current-edition cover preserved. No new visual design or artwork.
checklist.browser: Not executed: supported browser tool approval-review infrastructure unavailable. Fixture selection/language tests and exported-content checks are not a visual or full accessibility review.
checklist.scope_omissions: No new page family, form behavior, reading typography or services. Runtime and source hash checks retained; no production submissions.
checklist.handoff: Final synchronization and storage check follow this saved record.
checklist.publication: Local only; no push or deployment.

executor: Current chat assistant; Samanta implementation/Drishti self-review

tests.order: Final full test suite ran after the completed public build.

export.source_display_format: Existing four-line format retained, including the previously approved Odia display-only punctuation handling.

rotation.method: Actual selection function with IDs parsed from the exported homepage. Unit fixtures cover document replacement, storage, edition resets and language selection; not a native browser session.

browser.reason: The supported browser documentation request failed because the automatic approval review model was at capacity. Infrastructure failure, not an unsafe-action rejection; no alternate access used.

validation_corrections: First full test run exposed a stale article-coverage assertion tied to the previous engagement script cache version. Updated it to require the versioned module inclusion and reran all tests after the final build. Original failure log retained.

Export check initially compared two approved display-case titles directly to raw uppercase source titles. The evidence check now validates the existing source/display override record. No title or poem was changed.
limitations: Session storage unavailable or corrupt: a fresh random choice remains usable, but repeat avoidance cannot be guaranteed.
Back/forward restoration may retain the previous document; no timed changes while reading.
No-JavaScript content retains the static current-edition fallback.
No fresh visual, keyboard-in-browser or production provider check; existing layout and controls retained.
checks.publication: Local preview only; no push or deployment.
